description: Twist-N-Lite Cylinder Color-Select Pendant | USER SELECTION 2026-10-01: Maxim Lighting Trim Round 120V Ceiling Light, Black, 16 in., model 57670WTBK.
source_notes: NEEDS REVIEW 2026-10-01: Penthouse Bedroom 4 second unit S4-2 live row carries a Twist-N-Lite cylinder pendant, but the dedicated 1529 Lighting Fixture Schedule still defines S4-2 as an approximately 16" circular LED flush-mount ceiling fixture with selection TBD. Lightopia estimate 700122342 proposed Kuzco Brook 15" Flush Mount FM43315-BG-5CCT at $75.48 each; current Kuzco product data confirms FM43315-BG-5CCT is a 15-1/8" ceiling flush mount. Best sourced candidate is Brook, but the schedule never formally selected it and the 4/28/26 quote is expired. Retain live pendant/history; obtain final design approval and current quote before substitution. | RESOLVED BASE PACKAGE 2026-10-01: later Lightology Good project 17737 (8/26/26) and the 8/27 Good/Better/Best comparison deck explicitly assign WAC Lighting Twist-N-Lite spec WAC1314240 to the secondary-bedroom base package. The April Lightopia Brook FM43315-BG-5CCT quote is therefore retained as superseded vendor-alternative history, not the current Good/base identity. Existing carried unit cost is preserved; the Aug. 26 Good source shows $82.41 unit trade price, so price refresh remains a commercial follow-up rather than a selection blocker. | PROCUREMENT HOLD 2026-10-01: the August Lightology Good project confirms WAC1314240 only as the Good-tier comparison identity; it does not establish award. SHB sent an updated fixture list on 5/22, Lightopia issued estimate 700123242 on 5/27 with DALS Radiance FMM12-CC-BK for the secondary bedrooms, and on 7/30 SHB explicitly told Lightopia to keep the estimate open because finishes work was paused. Keep the live WAC line as the current Good-budget/reference line, but do not order until final fixture approval and current vendor quote/PO. | USER SELECTION CONFIRMED 2026-10-01: all bedroom ceiling fixtures, including Primary Bedrooms and Bedrooms 2-5, use Maxim Lighting Trim Round 120V Ceiling Light, Black, 16in, model 57670WTBK / Lightology Spec MAX1023280. Current public price $125.80 EA. Historical fixture identity and Actual Unit Cost remain preserved as prior design/pricing history. Count this Maxim fixture as the selected bedroom base scope.
